versions.changelog:
Initial release of slidev-antd-dashboard.

- Integrates ant-design-vue with Slidev to build dashboard and admin-UI slides.
- Provides setup instructions, theming guide, and dashboard design rules tailored for Slidev presentations.
- Covers use of all ant-design-vue components, composition best practices, and copy-paste example slides.
- Includes navigation/menu design guides and recommendations for incorporating charts using ECharts.
- Supplies drop-in assets and templates for rapid dashboard slide creation.
